title: feat(console): the sidebar's docking model: 1280 px starts expanded, the expand/collapse button is the one control, Recent lists this app (#36112)
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6okWxYPWAsooBsJoAhnT1u)_

repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oK4fFfnLADcipbEeT

Fixes #36112

This is PR B of two for the card: the sidebar's docking model. PR A (#36187) moved everything off the desktop top bar.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat claim: [#36112 claim](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/36112#issuecomment-7073260739). Ruling: [F1, 7069868269](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/36112#issuecomment-7069868269).

## 维护者速读

- 电脑上打开应用：窗口 1280 宽及以上侧边栏默认展开，更窄默认收起；收起和展开按钮是唯一开关，浏览器按宽窄两边各自记住；「保持侧边栏展开」开关去掉；侧边栏的「最近使用」只列当前应用里的；手机不变。
- 「去掉顶栏、侧栏常驻」这张卡的后一半，按你 11 月 21 日的裁定（1280 起默认展开，更窄才收起）收尾，合并后这张卡关闭。
- 出错时用户看到的是侧边栏开始时的展开或收起不对，点一下按钮就能改回，选择会被记住；只改界面，不动数据，可以直接撤回；以前选过「保持展开」的人在窄窗口上照旧是展开的。
- 无

## Upgrade change and accepted cost

- **Upgrade change (stated as the ruling asks):** on 1280–1415 px windows, a user who never set 「保持展开」 now starts with the sidebar expanded (it folded before), unless they had collapsed it on a wide window.
- **Accepted cost (stated on the card):** on a 1280 px window the list beside an open record drawer is 304 px wide (560 today), and on 1280–1415 px with the sidebar expanded, opening the comment panel returns the record page's fields to the tab row; collapsing the sidebar restores the three columns. The 304 / 560 figures are pinned in `consoleSidebarRail.width-27593.test.tsx` against the primitive's sidebar width and plugin-view's drawer width.

## What changes

`@object-ui/app-shell`

- `layout/consoleSidebarRail.ts`
  - `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_RAIL_BELOW_WIDTH` is `1280`, one constant, no longer derived (`RECORD_DRAWER_MIN_CONTENT_WIDTH` removed; the drawer and list constants stay, to state the accepted cost).
  - The narrow-window choice is `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_NARROW_OPEN_PREFERENCE` (was `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_KEEP_OPEN_PREFERENCE`), stored under the same name `console.sidebar.keepOpen`, so an existing `on` reads as "expanded on narrow" with no migration. The wide-window choice keeps its key (`os:console-sidebar:wide-open`). Wide and narrow stay stored separately.
  - New `startingSidebarOpen(wide)`: the reader's choice for that side, else expanded on wide and collapsed on narrow. `primeConsoleSidebarOpen` writes it into the primitive's cookie before the first frame; `seedWideWindowOpen` is gone (with an explicit wide default it has nothing to seed).
  - `useConsoleSidebarRail` answers `narrowOpen` / `setNarrowOpen` instead of `keepOpen` / `setKeepOpen`; `railMode` is "narrow and collapsed by the narrow choice".
  - `useConsoleSidebarRailPanel`: `keepOpenControl`, `dock` / `undock` and the `'dock'` closer are removed. While the sidebar is hidden, a press on a sidebar trigger (the page header's expand button, or the corner fallback) now docks it: on a narrow window the capture phase sets the narrow choice to expanded before the provider's toggle opens it, so the open is not a float. ⌘B still floats the menu over a collapsed sidebar (unchanged), and so does the left edge.
- `hooks/useResponsiveSidebar.ts`: gives a window its starting state on load and when it crosses 1280 px or the phone breakpoint; keeps an open/close on a wide window as the wide choice (only on a change, so a default is never recorded as a choice), and a close of the docked sidebar on a narrow window as the narrow choice; a narrow choice turned collapsed (this tab or another) collapses an open sidebar. Public signature unchanged.
- `layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`: the 「保持侧边栏展开」 footer row is gone (the foot holds only the account menu). From 768 px up the Recent group lists only entries whose address names the current app (resolved by `matchAppBySegment`, as Home resolves a recent row's app); the phone drawer is unchanged.

`@object-ui/i18n`: `sidebar.keepOpen` removed from all 11 packs (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`).

Text that named 1416 (the ruling's list, plus one more found by grep):

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts` comment (also corrected: it still described the retired 48 px icon rail). Comment only, no bump for plugin-detail.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` steps[2], revision 17 → 18 with a history row.
- `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`: its comment cited 1416 and the case docked the sidebar with the retired "Keep sidebar open"; it now docks with the page header's expand button.

## Tests

New (card-named):

- `layout/__tests__/consoleSidebarRail.docking-36112.test.tsx`: threshold 1280; first frame at 1279 collapsed and 1280 expanded whatever the cookie, 768 / 1920 edges, phone keeps the cookie; the mounted layout at 1279 → 1280; a stored choice beats the default on each side and the two sides stay apart; a raw legacy `os:pref:console.sidebar.keepOpen` record `{"value":"on","v":1}` reads as expanded on a narrow window.
- `layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.recentThisApp-36112.test.tsx`: Recent lists only this app's entries (other app, Setup, Studio item left out), its five are this app's newest five, no group when this app has none, and the phone drawer still lists every app's.

Rewritten (they encoded 1416 or the keep-open switch):

- `hooks/__tests__/useResponsiveSidebar.test.tsx`: defaults at 1279 / 1280, no choice recorded by a default, each side's state across the threshold, wide collapse kept, narrow close kept as the narrow choice, a narrow choice turned collapsed elsewhere, phone untouched.
- `layout/__tests__/ConsoleLayout.sidebarFirstFrame-28077.test.tsx`: 1280 → 1279 for the collapsed first frame; new cases for 1280 expanded against a collapsed cookie, a wide collapse, and a narrow expand.
- `layout/__tests__/consoleSidebarRail.width-27593.test.tsx`: no longer pins the derived 1416; pins 1280, the 256 px width (F2) and the 304 / 560 cost.
- `layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.hiddenCollapse-35062.test.tsx`: narrow width 1280 → 1024; the trigger-floats cases now float with ⌘B; the "Keep sidebar open" cases are replaced by "the expand button docks (wide and narrow), a reload keeps it, the collapse button takes it back", the legacy keep-open read, and "the expand button docks even when React renders between the capture phase and the trigger's handler" (the old render-between case, now for the dock).
- `layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.railOverlay-27593.test.tsx`: 1280 / 1360 → 1024; floats with ⌘B; the three "Keep sidebar open" cases and the Esc-on-keep-open case are replaced by the expand-button dock and the narrow/wide choices kept apart (objectstack#28079).
- `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` (see above).

Retired: none as a file. The removed cases are the ones that drove the retired control; each behaviour they pinned that still exists (float, Esc, focus, fold on navigation, choices kept apart) is pinned in the rewritten files above.

## Acceptance notes

Card acceptance, walked against main after PR A (a5a5312f) and this branch:

| Card acceptance line | Met by |
|:---|:---|
| Desktop app page: no top bar; sidebar on the left, content beside it, not covered | PR A (no top bar); this PR (docked by default from 1280 px; below it collapsed by default, as ruled) |
| Collapse: sidebar disappears, content widens, expand button top-left; left edge slides it out; still collapsed after refresh | PR A (collapse, expand button, edge); this PR (the expand button docks instead of floating; the choice is kept on both sides of 1280) |
| App name opens only the app list (search when many) and 「添加应用」; Setup for admins only; switching works | PR A |
| Sidebar search works, shortcut works | PR A |
| Avatar at the bottom; its menu has switch organization and sign out | PR A |
| Bell beside search; panel and count as before | PR A |
| Impersonation banner at the content top, exit works; lost-connection notice | PR A |
| List, record, dashboard, report, custom page all carry the page-actions group | #36111 and PR A (always on) |
| Phone width unchanged | PR A; this PR leaves the phone drawer's Recent unfiltered and the phone sidebar state untouched |
| Setup and Account use the new shell, menus unchanged | PR A |
| Onboarding walks through | PR A (the walkthrough component renders nothing on main; no step points at the top bar) |
| PR body: before/after desktop screenshots (expanded, collapsed, app menu, banner) and the changed components and rewritten tests | this PR (before/after shots at 1440, 1280 and 1279 (expanded, collapsed, app menu open, the 1279 expand press, and a reload after it), saved with the seat's evidence; the banner was not shot, see Acceptance notes; components and tests above) |
| Item 2: 「保持侧边栏展开」 removed | this PR |
| Item 5: Recent lists this app's items | this PR |

The PR A rows are read from PR A's body and main's code, not re-driven here except where the screenshots show them.

Browser evidence (showcase booted on a private port, console served by Vite from this branch; the before set from the same server with the three sidebar files and the English pack swapped back to the merge base, then restored to HEAD and checked by blob hash):

- Fresh profile, 1440 px: expanded, before and after. 1280 px: collapsed before, expanded after.
- 1279 px: collapsed on load in both. Pressing the expand button: before, the menu floats over the page with the 「Keep sidebar open」 row at its foot, and a reload brings back the collapsed state; after, the sidebar docks beside the page (content reflows), and a reload keeps it docked.
- App menu open at 1440: same in both (Showcase, Setup, Add app).
- The impersonation banner was not shot: it needs a second user to impersonate on a fresh database, and its surface is PR A's and is not changed here.
- Recent was not shot: a fresh profile has no recent items; the filter is pinned by `UnifiedSidebar.recentThisApp-36112` and its ablations L4 and L5.

Reading taken where the ruling is literal, carried as an open question in the report:

- The expand button's tooltip names ⌘B (it draws the chord the sidebar primitive answers to), but with ⌘B kept unchanged as ruled, ⌘B over a collapsed sidebar floats the menu while a press on the button docks it. Before this PR both floated. Either ⌘B docks too, or the tooltip stops naming it; this PR does neither and leaves it to the seat.

Out of scope, noted not filed: none.

Overlap: `overlap-check.mjs` exit 1 against #34223 (a draft from 2026-11-19 that already conflicts with main on another file) in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`; not merged around, per the order. #36234 and #36208 share the i18n packs and merge cleanly.

## Verification

Read first (riskiest first):

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/consoleSidebarRail.ts`, the capture listener in `useConsoleSidebarRailPanel` (expand docks; ⌘B floats) and `startingSidebarOpen`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useResponsiveSidebar.ts`, the layout effect (which transitions write which choice).
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, the `recentItems` filter.

Two-minute check: in a fresh browser profile open any app at a 1280 px window: the sidebar is expanded beside the page. Resize to 1279 px: it collapses and the page header shows the expand button; press it: the sidebar docks, and a reload keeps it docked.
